```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
View(ny_noaa)
class(ny_noaa)

```


```{r}


ny_noaa|>
  select(date) |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    day = lubridate::day(date)
  )

## to check whether data is in reasonable data 
ny_noaa |>
  summarize(
    min_tmax = min(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_tmax = max(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_tmin = min(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_tmin = max(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_prcp = min(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_prcp = max(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_snow = min(snow, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_snow = max(snow, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ny_noaa |>
  filter(snow < 0 | snow > 1000) |>
  count(snow, sort = TRUE)
```
